policies.title: Saudi ordinary passports: current Uzbekistan selector visa-free entry
policies.summary: Uzbekistan's live official eVisa country dataset assigns Saudi Arabia status 2, which the same service defines as visa-free entry for up to 30 days.
conditions: The live eVisa dataset identifies Saudi Arabia with status 2, and its current status endpoint defines that status as visa-free entry for up to 30 days.
The President's official site confirms that Uzbekistan introduced visa-free entry for Saudi citizens.

The current MFA visa-procedure page also retains Saudi Arabia in its eVisa-or-simplified-consular appendix. This unresolved official-source conflict means the live selector result should be rechecked before promotion; no work, residence, diplomatic, official, transit or special-document rule is established.
